description: This file defines the AutoFontEncoding class within the PdfSharp library. It contains methods for testing font encoding in PDF documents, including rendering text with different font encodings, measuring string dimensions, and ensuring proper font descriptor handling for font faces. It also includes sample code demonstrating text rendering and font handling with different Unicode characters and surrogate pairs.

classes.name: AutoFontEncoding
classes.description: A class providing methods to test and demonstrate font encoding, text rendering, and font descriptor correctness within PDF documents using PdfSharp.

methods.name: Ensure_one_PdfFontDescriptor_per_FontFace
methods.description: Creates a PDF with various fonts and texts, performs font encoding tests, and demonstrates font rendering with special characters and surrogate pairs.

methods.name: Test2
methods.description: Performs a font encoding test involving replacing characters and rendering text with different font options.

methods.name: MeasureString_Test
methods.description: Creates a PDF document to measure and compare string widths for texts with Unicode characters, surrogate pairs, and different font encodings.
